description: Encuentra series del INE y presenta sus cifras con periodo, unidad, definición y límites de comparación.

defaultPrompt: Find the current INE series for my question, with its units and latest observation date.
Compare these official Spanish statistics without mixing bases or periods.
interface.longDescription:
Find INE tables and series and calculate traceable changes while preserving units, dates and missing values.

An instruction-only assistant workflow: consult official sources using the host’s available browsing capabilities, compare user-provided documents, retain dates and identifiers, and produce source-linked analysis. A labelled historical example is included.

The package contains guidance, reference material and visual assets. Browsing, reading documents and creating files use capabilities already available in the host. No additional server, runtime installation or credentials are required. Source access and complete coverage must be verified for each task; no official endorsement or legal, financial, title or eligibility guarantee is implied.

name: ine-evidence
